title: Dispatch: reset executor review fixes — rest evidence, AC test matrix, boundary interleave (attempt 1)
description:
Follow-up fixes from the supervisor review of the item reset/timer executor (landed on branch eshyra-c7sx via eshyra-pukl, commits 0dc1454/7f481c3/f9f9565). Read `bd show eshyra-c7sx` for the parent spec and acceptance criteria, and `bd show eshyra-pukl` for the implementation report. The executor lives in `packages/core/src/state/itemResetExecutor.ts`; wiring in `packages/core/src/state/rest.ts`; spend anchors in `packages/core/src/state/itemState.ts`; tests in `packages/core/test/itemResetExecutor.test.ts`.

## Fix 1 — rest benefits drop clock-derived item reset evidence (BUG)

In `rest.ts` `complete()`, the benefits object is built with `itemResets: []` and only rest-event resets are pushed into it, while `time.itemResets` from the rest's internal `advanceWorldTime` call is discarded (note `itemTimerResolutions` IS carried over from `time`). An overnight long rest crossing dawn applies dawn regains to item state but the evidence never reaches the returned benefits or the persisted benefits_json. Fix: seed `benefits.itemResets` with `time.itemResets` (clock-derived first, then rest-event entries). Add an end-to-end regression test: a long rest whose window crosses dawn must surface the dawn reset evidence in the returned benefits AND apply the rest-event resets.

## Fix 2 — close the acceptance-criteria test gaps

The parent bead requires every reset shape in the committed pack to be exercised. Missing today (add to itemResetExecutor.test.ts or a rest-level test where end-to-end wiring is the point):

- dusk boundary (charges/dusk/dice-expr — robe-of-stars shape): crossing minute 1080 fires; crossing dawn only does not.
- days-anchored cooldown (cooldown/days:7/all — horn-of-valhalla shape): spend to zero sets availableAt = spend + 7*1440; advancing 7 days restores to max and clears availableAt; advancing less does not.
- charges/days/all with onDepleted becomes:'inert' (figurine shape): depletion sets inert + availableAt; after 7 days the economy refills AND the inert lifecycle clears (end-to-end through useItem depletion, not hand-written state).
- budget/days/all (manual/tome shape, days:36500): same anchored path at century scale (use a smaller days value only if safe-integer limits force it — they do not).
- budget/long-rest/all (boots-of-speed shape) and per-day/long-rest/all (ring-of-x-ray-vision shape) through `completeLongRest` end-to-end: participant-held item regains; a NON-participant's item does not.
- multi-boundary crossing: one advance spanning 3 dawns rolls the dice regain 3 times (3 evidence entries, distinct boundaryElapsedMinutes, clamped total) — the parent AC names this case.
- timer resolution via rest completion (a short rest whose 60 minutes pass a pending timer deadline resolves it and surfaces it in benefits.itemTimerResolutions).

Prefer synthetic fixtures shaped exactly like the named pack items (existing fixture() helper); where a test is cheap to run against the real bundled record (e.g. frost-brand), that is even better evidence.

## Fix 3 — chronological boundary interleaving (hardening)

`resolveDueItemClockEvents` processes ALL dawn crossings for an item, then ALL dusk crossings. For an economy declaring both dawn and dusk resets, a multi-day advance applies dawn@day2 before dusk@day1; the lastReset guard then skips dusk@day1 entirely (out-of-order boundary). No committed pack item declares both, but the schema allows it. Fix: merge the dawn and dusk boundary streams per item and process chronologically (tag each boundary with its event). Add a unit test with a both-dawn-and-dusk fixture advancing two days asserting all four boundaries apply in order.

## Constraints

- Do not change the executor's documented semantics (docs/item-reset-executor.md) except to clarify; do not touch pack data or importer code.
- All state writes stay on the authoritative validateItemStateForRecord + writeItemState path.
- `npm run verify:worktree` fully green before commit. Work only in this worktree; commit on this branch; do not push or open a PR.
